// Synthetic, local fixture only. Never installed as the runtime vulnerability feed.
package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "time"
    fixtures "github.com/aquasecurity/bolt-fixtures"
)

func main() {
    if len(os.Args)!=2 { panic("fixture output directory required") }
    dest:=os.Args[1]
    if err:=os.MkdirAll(dest,0755);err!=nil {panic(err)}
    yaml:=`- bucket: debian 12
  pairs:
    - bucket: apache2
      pairs:
        - key: CVE-2020-11985
          value:
            FixedVersion: "2.4.25-1"
- bucket: data-source
  pairs:
    - key: debian 12
      value:
        ID: "debian"
        Name: "Synthetic historical fixture, NOT public feed"
        URL: "https://example.invalid/synthetic-advisory"
- bucket: vulnerability
  pairs:
    - key: CVE-2020-11985
      value:
        Title: "Synthetic historical test only"
        Description: "Fixture exercises version comparison, never a current vulnerability feed"
        Severity: "HIGH"
        VendorSeverity:
          debian: 3
        References:
          - "https://example.invalid/synthetic-advisory"
`
    path:=filepath.Join(dest,"fixture.yaml")
    if err:=os.WriteFile(path,[]byte(yaml),0644);err!=nil {panic(err)}
    loader,err:=fixtures.New(filepath.Join(dest,"trivy.db"),[]string{path});if err!=nil {panic(err)}
    if err=loader.Load();err!=nil {panic(err)}
    if err=loader.Close();err!=nil {panic(err)}
    now:=time.Now().UTC()
    meta:=map[string]interface{}{"Version":2,"UpdatedAt":now,"NextUpdate":now.Add(24*time.Hour),"DownloadedAt":now}
    data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(meta,"","  ");if err!=nil {panic(err)}
    if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dest,"metadata.json"),data,0644);err!=nil {panic(err)}
    fmt.Println("SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_READY")
}
